svg.title: Lead dioxide powder, as printed
svg.desc: Formula-unit atom-count illustration for the reported oxide powder. Positions are a graphic layout, not a discrete oxide molecule, measured lattice, polymorph or glass-network geometry. No atomic coordinate download is implied. The source repeatedly prints PbO2; it has not been changed to PbO or assigned a retained melt oxidation state.
svg.text: Formula-unit composition · no bonds or lattice assigned
Powder phase and atomic structure are not reported
